title: Jai Joundi Agayi Bazaran Chon Tera Chehlum Veer Karawan Gi
body:
Be Waarisan Vaangu Chad Chaliyan, Be Waarisan Vaangu Chad Chaliyan
Teri Soni Kabar Banawan Gi
<<DIVIDER>>
Pathran Vich Laash Nu Chor Ke Shaam De Raah Chaliyan
Nanay Da Deen Bachawan Baaj Rida Chaliyan
Waada Ay Ujri Zainab Da, Tenu Kafan Vi Aan Ke Pawan Gi
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri Laash Ne Tapdi Rait Ch Ruldeya Hona Ay
Main Kayi Kayi Ghantay Vich Darbar Khalona Ay
Tu Saang Te Paak Quran Parhin, Main Khutbay Veer Sunawan Gi
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri Kand Te Char Kay Shimr Nay Zulam Kamaya Ay
Mere Sir Ton Burqa Naize De Nal Laya Ay
Bhai Waal Haan Teri Chan Veeran, Tere Saaray Dard Wandawan Gi
<<DIVIDER>>
Kiwain Sang Barsaaye Aan Ke Bheer Bazari Nay
Sanu Zakhmi Vekh Ke Ronay Khoon Muhari Nay
Bakiye Vich Jaa Ke Amri Nu, Rasiyan De Daagh Vakhawan Gi
<<DIVIDER>>
Akhtar Haye Sikdi Mar Gayi Sain Sakina Ay
Ujri Nu Kabar Mili Na Pyu Da Seena Ay
Jeri Soch Di Rayi Karbal Jaa Ke, Babay Nu Gal Nal Laawan Gi
